items.title: Trump kündigt Treffen zwischen Selenskyj und Putin „bald“ an
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump erklärte vor Journalisten, ein Treffen zwischen dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj und dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin solle bald stattfinden.

items.title: Sorge vor Gewalt - Verfassungsschutz warnt vor Einfluss von Linksextremisten auf geplante Jugendproteste
items.teaser: Das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz hat vor einer Instrumentalisierung der für Samstag geplanten Jugendproteste durch linksextremistische Gruppen gewarnt.

items.title: Russian forces strike Kharkiv, killing one and injuring three
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck Kharkiv’s Osnovianskyi district, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: Russian marketplace Ozon estimates losses from drone attacks on warehouses at over 30 billion rubles
items.teaser: Russian online marketplace Ozon has estimated its losses from drone attacks on its logistics facilities at 30.1 billion rubles.

items.title: In Region Tula brennt nach Drohnenangriff Chemiewerk „Azot“
items.teaser: In der Stadt Nowomoskowsk in der Region Tula ist das Werk der Nowomoskowsker Aktiengesellschaft „Azot“ nach dem Drohnenangriff in Brand geraten.

items.title: Ukraine's foreign intelligence chief warns that fake messages are being sent in his name to gain information on negotiations
items.teaser: Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence chief Rustem Umierov has said fake messages in his name are targeting diplomats to obtain information on peace negotiations.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in the Netherlands
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in the Netherlands for an official visit.

items.title: Zelenskyy arrives in Netherlands – video
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has begun an official visit to the Netherlands to discuss military support, economic cooperation, and joint security initiatives.

items.title: Three Russian air defense assets hit over past 24 hours, General Staff says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck three Russian air defense assets on Russian territory on October 27 and overnight into October 28. The targets included a Tor surface-to-air missile system, a radar station, and an electronic warfare system.

items.title: Wenige Tage vor Demonstration: "Gen Z regelt"-Unterstützer springen ab - versinkt der Protest im Chaos?
items.teaser: Der große Protesttag rückt näher: Für kommenden Samstag ruft die Organisation "Gen Z regelt" deutschlandweit zu Demonstrationen auf. Doch nun befürchten bisherige Unterstützer Chaos - und gehen auf Distanz. Auch der Verfassungsschutz ist besorgt.

items.title: Ukraine’s parliament approves 2027 state budget in first reading
items.teaser: With security and defense allocations accounting for around two-thirds of planned expenditure and a projected deficit of nearly Hr 1.7 trillion ($37 billion), the budget highlights the challenge of funding the war while maintaining economic stability and meeting social commitments.

items.title: Zelensky tasks PM with assembling Kyiv winter preparations team, says Klitschko 'can't do it alone'
items.teaser: "It would be wonderful if Kyiv could protect itself or at least prepare for the dangers. But that didn't happen in any of these areas," Zelensky said.

items.title: Ukraine’s indigenous ballistic missiles could put Russia’s best-defended targets at risk, Turkish expert says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s development and use of its own ballistic missiles will pose a greater challenge to Russia by making some of its best-protected targets vulnerable.

items.title: Bund lässt mehr Beschäftigte auf Sabotagerisiko prüfen
items.teaser: Stromnetz, Wasserwerke, LNG-Terminals: Der Bund will künftig Beschäftigte in noch mehr Betrieben daraufhin überprüfen lassen, ob sie anfällig dafür sind, als Innentäter den Betrieb zu sabotieren.

items.title: Ukraine paused attacks on oil refineries for 3 days as Russia continued strikes on energy infrastructure, Zelensky says
items.teaser: During those days, Ukrainian forces acted "a little more cautiously," but were not ordered to refrain from responding to Russian strikes, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: One killed and three injured in Russian drone strike on Kharkiv
items.teaser: A 60-year-old man was killed and three other men were injured when Russian forces struck Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district with an attack drone on 28 October.

items.title: A Russian cruise missile that doesn’t match its name fell almost intact in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: A box-shaped body, a V-tail, composite skin: Ukrainian specialists can now study Russia’s new design up close.

items.title: "Gen-Z"-Proteste: Verfassungsschutz warnt vor linksextremen Einflüssen
items.teaser: In Hamburg und anderen Städten wollen am Samstag Jugendliche für bessere Bildung protestieren. Verfassungsschutz und Polizei beobachten die Lage genau.

items.title: 2027 State Budget draft approved in first reading
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada has approved the draft law on Ukraine’s 2027 state budget in the first reading, with 239 lawmakers voting in favor.

items.title: Zelensky lands in Netherlands to discuss air defense, economic partnership
items.teaser: "We will discuss defense and economic cooperation, strengthening Ukrainian air defense, and new steps to support Ukraine," Zelensky said on X upon his arrival.

items.title: A warehouse by day, homes by night: Russian jet drones keep hitting Kharkiv
items.teaser: Five people were hurt, a 4-year-old among them, and the next day a Russian drone hit the same district again, killing one person and injuring two.

items.title: Canadian volunteer, who rescued hundreds of animals, killed in Russian drone strike in Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Canadian volunteer Jesse Adams, who rescued animals and helped people in Ukraine, has been killed by a Russian drone strike while evacuating animals in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Selenskyj: Abschaltung von Starlink/Starshield ist einer der Gründe für zivile Todesopfer bei Angriffen
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute vor Journalisten, die Verlangsamung des Betriebs der Starlink/Starshield-Satellitendienste sei einer der Gründe für zivile Todesopfer bei russischen Luftangriffen. Er fügte hinzu, er wisse nicht, wer den Befehl zur Drosselung des Betriebs dieser Dienste gegeben habe.

items.title: Russia is building drone launch site near Millerovo to launch up to 100 Geran UAVs a day, Ukrainian intelligence says – photos
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says satellite images show a new Geran-4 and Geran-5 launch site near Millerovo airfield, built in about two months.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau rejects fugitive prosecutor general Kravchenko's allegations
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) has rejected former prosecutor general Ruslan Kravchenko's claims that it was involved in a plot to carry out "violent acts" against him, describing them as an attempt to obtain protection abroad.

items.title: Netherlands to provide Ukraine with €1.2B in non-military aid over three years
items.teaser: The Dutch government will provide Ukraine with €1.2 billion in non-military assistance over the next three years. The funding will primarily support the energy and water supply sectors, Ukraine’s recovery and reconstruction, and cooperation between Ukrainian and Dutch businesses.

items.title: Ukrainian monitors report fire near Russian plant that sold steel to an S-400 missile builder
items.teaser: Lipetsk’s governor denies any large industrial fire, saying drone debris set a tree belt alight.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike three Russian air defence assets
items.teaser: The General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck a Tor-M2 system, a radar and an electronic warfare station in Russia, plus a supply depot in occupied Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces step up assaults on Huliaipole axis, National Guard says
items.teaser: Russian forces have stepped up assaults on the Huliaipole axis in recent days. Meanwhile, the highest number of combat engagements has been reported on the Pokrovsk axis, with heavy fighting also reported on the Ocheretyne and Kostiantynivka axes.

items.title: 2 Russian army deserters arrested while heading for Kyiv
items.teaser: Both were detained when trying to cross into Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, and one "was found to be wearing a Russian military identification tag around his neck," SBU said.

items.title: Nearly 50 companies involved in producing Russia's Starlink alternative, 23 not under international sanctions, HUR says
items.teaser: Rassvet's planned coverage is expected to focus primarily on Ukraine and Europe, HUR said, warning that the system could also support Russian hybrid operations against other countries.

items.title: 16 Suspects detained in major stolen drones scheme
items.teaser: Law enforcement officials have uncovered a large-scale scheme in which drones were allegedly stolen from military units, had their markings altered, and were resold to the military as new, according to investigators.

items.title: An der Front 191 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 27. Oktober, zu 191 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Mittwoch, dem 28. Oktober, melden.

items.title: Fugitive prosecutor general Kravchenko accuses Ukraine of plotting "violent acts" against him, stays silent on why he has not returned
items.teaser: Former Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko accuses NABU, SAPO and the President’s Office of planning “violent acts” against him, but does not explain why he has not returned to Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian MP elected president of OSCE Parliamentary Assembly
items.teaser: Mykyta Poturaiev, Chair of the Verkhovna Rada Committee on Humanitarian and Information Policy, has been elected president of the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly.

items.title: Vor israelischer Botschaft: Anschlag in Serbien - Minderjähriger attackiert Polizisten
items.teaser: Höchste Terrorwarnstufe in Serbien: Kurz nach Mitternacht greift ein junger Serbe einen Polizisten in Belgrad an - dabei soll er "Allahu akbar!" gerufen haben. Der mutmaßlich Minderjährige ist den Behörden bereits bekannt.

items.title: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers and cyberspace, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

items.title: Ukrainian forces report no further Russian infiltration into Kupiansk after Operation Veles
items.teaser: Joint Forces Group spokesman Viktor Trehubov said Russian troops, who infiltrated northern Kupiansk via a pipeline, have not been seen entering since Operation Veles.

items.title: Press officer with Ukraine's Borysfen Brigade killed in Kherson
items.teaser: Volodymyr Obertas, a press officer with the Borysfen Brigade, has been killed in Kherson. He was a native of Oleshky, a city currently occupied by Russian forces.

items.title: Serbien: Höchste Terrorwarnstufe nach Anschlag vor israelischer Botschaft
items.teaser: Erneut wird ein Wachbeamter vor der israelischen Botschaft in Belgrad angegriffen. Der Vorfall weckt Erinnerungen – welche Sicherheitsmaßnahmen Serbien jetzt ergreift.

items.title: Ukraine receives 12 Patriot missiles per month from US, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine needs to intercept around 150 Russian ballistic missiles per month but receives about 150 Patriot missiles from the U.S. annually, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Netherlands confirms $1.3 billion in non-military aid for Ukraine through 2029
items.teaser: "Support for recovery and reconstruction can't wait for a ceasefire. Ukraine needs our help right now: military support, but also social and economic assistance," Dutch Foreign Trade Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma said during his visit to Kyiv.

items.title: Trump says Zelensky and Putin will meet “very soon”
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that a meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian leader Vladimir Putin is expected to take place soon.

items.title: Luftabwehr schießt ab/neutralisiert 71 russische Kamikaze-Drohnen
items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 71 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.title: Russia in Africa: What is Putin hoping to achieve?
items.teaser: Following its invasion of Ukraine and the resulting rift with the West, Russia has declared that it intends to make a "historic return" to Africa. What have we seen of this so far?

items.title: Netherlands to provide Ukraine with over €1bn in non-military aid
items.teaser: The Netherlands will provide Ukraine with €1.2 billion in non-military aid over the next three years to support recovery and reconstruction and to create opportunities for Dutch businesses.

items.title: Zelensky: All forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky states that all forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy to meet Dutch PM and King Willem-Alexander on 28 October
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president will meet with Dutch government officials, business leaders and King Willem-Alexander to discuss defence and bilateral cooperation.

items.title: Poll: 80% of Ukrainians support strikes on Russian oil refineries, even if US cuts aid
items.teaser: A new KIIS poll has revealed strong public backing for strikes on Russian oil refineries and highlights that 63% of citizens are willing to endure the war in the long term.

items.title: In diesem Jahr erhält Ukraine durchschnittlich nur zwölf Raketen pro Monat für Patriot-Systeme – Selenskyj
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute vor Journalisten, dass die Ukraine in diesem Jahr durchschnittlich nur zwölf Raketen pro Monat für die Patriot-Systeme erhält.

items.title: Ceasefire in Oleshky enters 30th hour as Russian strikes kill 2, injure 17 elsewhere in Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched an Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missile and 88 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine, including 38 jet-powered drones, overnight on Oct. 28.

items.title: Zelenskyy on his rhetoric towards Trump: No time for quiet signals
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy explains his direct rhetoric towards Donald Trump, saying Ukraine has no time for ‘quiet signals’ amid Russian attacks and a shortage of anti-ballistic missiles

items.title: Zelensky: Russia appears serious about Abu Dhabi meeting
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that following the conversation between European leaders and Russian President Putin, there is a sense that Russia is seriously committed to the meeting of the negotiating teams in Abu Dhabi, during which they plan to discuss the first steps toward de-escalation in the energy sector

items.title: Zelensky backs Norway-Finland talks with Putin, says Trump already ended Russia's isolation
items.teaser: Zelensky praised Norway and Finland for putting their diplomacy "completely out in the open: discussions in advance, a full briefing, and transparent objectives," saying that not all countries had taken the time to speak with Ukraine beforehand.

items.title: When Does a Tribunal’s Reasoning Become a Breach of the Right to Be Heard? Lessons from Singapore
items.teaser: How far may an arbitral tribunal go beyond the reasoning advanced by the parties without violating the parties’ right to be heard? items.title: Russen töten zwei und verletzen drei Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 27. Oktober töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk zwei Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Zelenskyy says diesel deal could mark start of further Russia-US agreements
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has noted that the diesel arrangement could lead to broader discussions on frozen assets, energy resources and the lifting of sanctions on Russian entities.

items.title: Zelenskyy says he has no alternative to peace negotiating group, but is open to proposals
items.teaser: While acknowledging various opinions from experienced politicians, Zelenskyy has emphasised that his current delegation continues its vital diplomatic work

items.title: Zelensky pushes back against Musk, says Ukraine uses Starshield to defend itself
items.teaser: "When Elon Musk said that we use Starshield against the Russians — yes, against the Russians, but on our own territory. This is not offensive; it’s defensive," Zelensky told journalists at a press briefing.

items.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Trump kündigt "sehr bald" ein Treffen an
items.teaser: Zwischen den USA, Russland und der Ukraine könnte es bald zu neuen Verhandlungen kommen. US-Präsident Donald Trump zeigt sich zuversichtlich.

items.title: Ukraine's human rights commissioner: No incidents in Oleshky since ceasefire began 30 hours ago
items.teaser: Ukraine’s human rights commissioner Dmytro Lubinets says no incidents were recorded during the first 30 hours of the ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky.

items.title: Zelensky: Abu Dhabi meeting depends on U.S. side
items.teaser: Whether the trilateral meeting of technical teams from Ukraine, Russia, and the U.S.—scheduled for early November—takes place depends on the American side.

items.title: Two weeks before Starlink’s speed cap hit Ukraine’s drones, a Ukrainian test satellite went up on a SpaceX rocket
items.teaser: The companies say it will serve Ukraine's strategic security. Public launch records list one Ukrainian satellite from that launch, and it has a different name, though dozens of the launch's payloads are still unidentified.

items.title: Korezkyj erörtert mit dem Präsidenten litauischen Seimas Unterstützung europäischer Integration und Energiehilfe für Ukraine
items.teaser: Ministerpräsident Serhij Korezkyj gab gestern am späten Abend auf Facebook bekannt, er habe mit dem Präsidenten des litauischen Seimas, Juozas Olekas, die Unterstützung der europäischen Integration der Ukraine, zusätzliche Beiträge zum Energiefonds und die Stärkung der Verkehrsinfrastruktur erörtert.

items.title: Kyiv's housing market feels the chill as residents escape ahead of winter
items.teaser: Subscribe to the Newsletter Ukraine Business Roundup Subscribe As temperatures are falling in Kyiv, so are rent prices, with residents leaving the capital to escape Russian bombardment and the prospect of a winter without heating and electricity. Over the last two months, the number of long-term rentals listed on Kyiv&

items.title: Zelenskyy discloses who was invited to head Kyiv ahead of winter
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has revealed that multiple managers and former officials refused offers to head the Kyiv Administration before the heating season.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia seems serious about talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has outlined the agenda for the November negotiations, highlighting security guarantees, POW swaps and ending the war.

items.title: Russian airstrike on Sloviansk city center injures one person
items.teaser: On the evening of October 27, Russian troops carried out an airstrike on the center of Sloviansk; a woman was injured, and a school building was destroyed.

items.title: Russia wants deal with NATO to reshape Europe's security order, Zelensky says
items.teaser: The Kremlin is repackaging these demands as "security guarantees" for itself amid ongoing negotiations to end the war in Ukraine, Zelensky told journalists at a press briefing.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland hat innerhalb von zwei Wochen über 100 ballistische Raketen auf Kyjiw und Region abgefeuert
items.teaser: Innerhalb von zwei Wochen hat Russland über 100 ballistische Raketen gegen Kyjiw und die Region Kyjiw eingesetzt. Derzeit fehlen der Ukraine Raketen für die Patriot-Luftverteidigungssysteme, und die Hilfslieferungen verzögern sich.

items.title: Ukraine's intelligence names nearly 50 companies involved in developing Russia's Starlink rival
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) has released information on 49 Russian and Belarusian companies involved in developing Rassvet, a satellite communications system that Russia is developing as an alternative to Starlink.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,583,350 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,510 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: “Above all, we do not have enough missiles for Patriots”—Zelenskyy after 100+ ballistic missiles
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says delays in US-approved air defense supplies help Russia’s strikes and weaken Ukraine’s hand in diplomacy.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine receives average of just 12 Patriot missiles per month this year
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that this year, Ukraine is receiving an average of only 12 missiles per month for its Patriot systems.

items.title: 1510 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 28. Oktober 2026 werden auf etwa 1.583350 (+1510 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: War update: Over 190 clashes on front lines in past day, most Russian attacks on Pokrovsk axis
items.teaser: A total of 191 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on October 27.

items.title: Air defenses neutralize 71 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces have neutralized 71 Russian drones since the evening of October 27.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 41 Ortschaften beschossen, zwei Zivilisten verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 41 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 846 Mal.

items.title: EU sanctions against ISIL/Da’esh and Al-Qaeda: Council renews regime until 2027
items.teaser: The Council extended restrictive measures against individuals and groups associated with ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaeda for a further year, until 31 October 2027.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,510 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 28, 2026, have reached approximately 1,583,350 personnel, including 1,510 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Nordrhein-Westfalen - Unbekannter durchbricht Zaun an Umspannwerk in Marl und flüchtet
items.teaser: Im nordrhein-westfälischen Marl hat es möglicherweise einen Anschlagsversuch auf die Strom-Infrastruktur gegeben.

items.title: In Lipezk brennt nach dem Angriff ein Hüttenwerk
items.teaser: Die russische Stadt Lipezk wurde nach vorläufigen Angaben mit Raketen attackiert. Im Raum des Nowolipezker Hüttenwerks brach ein Feuer aus.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 846 times over past 24 hours, two injured
items.teaser: Russian troops launched 846 attacks on 41 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Two people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to five
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district has risen to five, including a child.

items.title: 'Cognitive erosion' has become a new target of disinformation – expert
items.teaser: The strategy behind modern disinformation operations has undergone significant changes. With the development of artificial intelligence technologies, hostile actors are increasingly abandoning attempts to persuade audiences of anything in favor of what is known as "cognitive erosion."

items.title: Norway extradites banker suspected of stealing over UAH 1M from customers' accounts to Ukraine
items.teaser: A former bank employee from Ukraine's Ternopil region, suspected of misappropriating customers' funds and wanted internationally, has been extradited from Norway to Ukraine.

items.title: Putin lectured Nordic leaders on Russian history during latest call, FT reports
items.teaser: Russian President Vladimir Putin delivered a lengthy lecture on medieval Slavic history to the leaders of Norway and Finland during an Oct. 27 phone call, offering little mention of an immediate ceasefire despite renewed diplomatic efforts to end Moscow's war in Ukraine, the Financial Times (FT) reported.

items.title: Fire reported at steelworks in Russia's Lipetsk after attack – social media
items.teaser: The Russian city of Lipetsk was targeted by jet-powered projectiles, and a fire reportedly broke out near the Novolipetsk steel mill (NLMK), according to preliminary information.

items.title: Kyiv to allocate UAH 1 bn for water crossings over the Dnipro, Klitschko says
items.teaser: Additional technical solutions are being developed to preserve the structural integrity of bridges across the Dnipro River amid attacks on critical infrastructure in the capital.

items.title: Russia launched over 100 ballistic missiles against Kyiv in past two weeks
items.teaser: Zelensky's comments come one day Russian ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv in a deadly attack on a university campus, a major bridge, an administrative building, and medical facilities in Kyiv. The attack killed one person and injured 15.

items.title: Norway allocates nearly $54M in energy support for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Norwegian government announced on Tuesday, October 27, that it would provide 500 million kroner (nearly $54 million) in energy support for Ukraine ahead of winter.

items.title: Putin gives 90-minute "history lecture" during call with Norwegian and Finnish leaders
items.teaser: A phone call intended to discuss ending the war became a lengthy monologue by Vladimir Putin on what the Kremlin calls the conflict's "initial reasons", with an immediate ceasefire receiving little attention.

items.title: UN chief appoints Russian diplomat to oversee mine action and police
items.teaser: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has appointed Russia's ambassador Gleb Desyatnikov as Assistant Secretary-General for Mine Action and Police in the Department of Peace Operations.

items.title: Ukrposhta cuts network to 7,211 branches over three years, Lubinets says
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, the Verkhovna Rada Commissioner for Human Rights, announced a reduction in the Ukrposhta network from 10,000 to 7,211 branches and provided the company with recommendations on tracking mobile branches and ensuring citizens’ access to postal services.

items.title: PM Koretskyi orders faster repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has instructed the Ministry for Recovery, Infrastructure and Transport to speed up repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge, which was damaged in a Russian missile attack overnight on October 27.

items.title: Fire breaks out at steelworks in Russia's Lipetsk after attack – photos and videos
items.teaser: Monitoring Telegram channels report a fire near the Novolipetsk Steel plant in the Russian city of Lipetsk following an attack involving jet-powered assets on 27 October.

items.title: Italian PM freezes new military aid package for Ukraine ahead of US midterm elections
items.teaser: Italian media outlets report that Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has postponed the delivery of a fully prepared military aid package to Kyiv, with no confirmed dispatch date despite the government's public commitment to continue supporting Ukraine.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1707: UN commission finds Russia’s strikes on Ukraine’s power grid are crimes against humanity
items.teaser: Russian missiles hit a Kyiv university campus and the Southern Bridge in two overnight waves and the ceasefire around occupied Oleshky began earlier than planned.

items.title: Soldier who held position alone for 491 days nominated for Hero of Ukraine title
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada supported an appeal to the President to award the title of Hero of Ukraine to serviceman Kostiantyn Vlasenko, who held a combat position in the Kupiansk sector for 491 days and was evacuated after suffering severe injuries during a unique aerial evacuation operation.

items.title: Fires burn in Russian city of Lipetsk after reported Ukrainian attack
items.teaser: A fire broke out in the area of the Novolipetsk Metallurgical Plant after air defenses were engaged, according to Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova Plus.

items.title: Russia replaces Ukrainians with Russian settlers in occupied Kherson Oblast; only 10–20% of pre-war population remains, Ukraine says
items.teaser: Russia is forcing Ukrainians from their homes while offering Russian teachers and medical workers financial incentives to settle in occupied Kherson Oblast, Ukraine’s military intelligence says.

items.title: Azov fighter sentenced to 29 years by Russia returns from captivity
items.teaser: As a result of the prisoner exchange on October 23, Azov soldier Taras Zvarychuk returned from Russian captivity; the occupiers had sentenced him to 29 years in prison “for terrorism.”

items.title: Finland and Norway leaders make rare direct call to Putin, breaking with the West’s diplomatic isolation of the Russian leader to influence Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: The Nordic leaders called for de-escalation ahead of November peace talks, with Zelenskyy saying they pressed Putin over attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure. The Kremlin reiterated that any settlement must account for Russia’s demands.

items.title: Russian forces strike apartment building in Kharkiv, casualties reported
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an apartment building in Kharkiv’s Osnovianskyi district. Casualties have been reported preliminarily.

items.title: Oleshky ceasefire expands beyond occupied town as truce holds without reported violations
items.teaser: The expanded ceasefire zone aims to secure humanitarian convoys to Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents face shortages of food and medicine.

items.title: War update: 178 clashes on front line, Pokrovsk sector remains hottest
items.teaser: A total of 178 combat clashes between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops were recorded on October 26, with Russian forces launching 24 attacks in the Pokrovsk sector.

items.title: Claudia Major, German Marshall Fund, zum Vorstoß von Norwegen und Finnland im Ukraine-Krieg
items.teaser: Claudia Major, German Marshall Fund, zum Vorstoß von Norwegen und Finnland im Ukraine-Krieg

items.title: Trump reportedly considering lifting sanctions against Russia's investment fund
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump is considering lifting sanctions against Russia's government investment fund, the New York Times reported Oct. 27, citing an unnamed U.S. official.

items.title: President Zelensky accepts letters of credence from ambassadors of five countries
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky accepted the letters of credence from the newly appointed ambassadors of Canada, Spain, Switzerland, Egypt and Türkiye to Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine intercepts nearly 60% of Russia’s Geran-4 jet drones, General Staff says, as Kyiv races to counter evolving threat
items.teaser: Ukraine’s interception rate reaches 80% during some attacks, as F-16s, Mirage jets, mobile fire groups, and interceptor drones help counter Russia’s jet-powered attacks.

items.title: PM Koretskyi discusses EU integration support, energy assistance for Ukraine with Lithuanian Seimas Speaker
items.teaser: Prime Minister of Ukraine Sergii Koretskyi discussed support for Ukraine’s European integration, additional contributions to the Energy Support Fund and strengthening transport infrastructure during a meeting with Lithuanian Seimas Speaker Juozas Olekas.

items.title: Europe must be involved in decisions on ending war – Zelensky

items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an educational facility with fiber-optic FPV drones in the Novhorod-Siverskyi community of the Chernihiv region.

items.teaser: Six people, including a child, have been injured in Russian strikes on two districts of Chernihiv Oblast.

items.teaser: Russian strikes on the night of 26-27 October have damaged energy infrastructure across eight Ukrainian oblasts, causing emergency power outages.

items.title: Battlefield in Kherson Region’s island area is now “transparent”, military says
items.teaser: Thanks to technology, the battlefield in the island area of the Kherson region is now “transparent.” Attempts by Russian forces to advance and establish positions end with their destruction, while Russian troops have failed to land in Kherson’s Korabel neighborhood.

items.title: Trump's son spent two days hunting in Mongolia with a Russian oligarch

items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky, commenting on a new Russian attack involving ballistic missiles, said that artificial and prolonged delays in deliveries of interceptors for Patriot and NASAMS air defense systems directly help Russia achieve the objectives of its terrorist campaign.

items.teaser: Die humanitäre Mission in der Stadt Oleschky hat begonnen. In dem Gebiet, in dem sie durchgeführt wird, wurde ein Waffenstillstand auf beiden Seiten ausgerufen.

items.teaser: As of 9 a.m., Russian forces were observing the ceasefire in the area of Oleshky where a humanitarian mission is being conducted.

items.title: Russian attack damages DTEK office in Kyiv
items.teaser: Emergency services and repair crews have responded after a DTEK Kyiv Grids facility was hit during the massive 27 October barrage targeting the capital.

items.title: Most of Konotop without power for fourth day after Russian Strikes; water supplied on schedule
items.teaser: Much of Konotop, in Ukraine’s Sumy region, has been without electricity for the fourth consecutive day following Russian strikes.

items.title: Russian diesel heads to US aboard tanker under EU sanctions
items.teaser: Three tankers carrying 140,000 tonnes of Russian diesel are heading to the US under a Trump-Putin deal. One vessel is under EU, UK and Canadian sanctions.

items.title: Three killed, eight injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv Region over past day
items.teaser: Three people were killed and eight others injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv and 12 other settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past day.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia strikes Ukraine with 16 ballistic missiles – video
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has linked Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv's logistics to delayed US sign-offs for Patriot and NASAMS air defence interceptors.

items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 255 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.teaser: Romania's Intelligence Service said on Monday it had identified a sabotage network coordinated by Russia, which it believed was responsible for a fire in September at an industrial site in central Romania near a state-owned weapons company.

items.title: The Trump administration is backing Orbán, who blocked a €90 billion EU loan to Ukraine, for UN secretary-general and is counting on support from Moscow and Beijing, WSJ says
items.teaser: Orbán indicated that he was willing to consider the nomination but did not want to enter the race without being confident he could win, according to the WSJ’s editorial board.

items.teaser: Israel wählt ein neues Parlament. Dabei steht die Macht von Ministerpräsident Benjamin Netanjahu auf dem Spiel. Russland und die Ukraine lassen lokal begrenzt Waffen schweigen. Der DW-Nachrichtenüberblick.

items.teaser: Am 26. Oktober töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk drei Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Russia builds shelters for Geran drones at Crimean airbase – photos
items.teaser: Satellite imagery reveals Russia is constructing over 60 new shelters, revetments and mobile launch facilities for Geran strike drones at Hvardiiske airbase.

items.teaser: Russia has lost 1,581,840 troops in Ukraine since the beginning of its full-scale invasion on Feb. 24, 2022, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported on Oct. 27. The number includes 1,400 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day. According to the

items.title: Main attack targets Kyiv: Russia launches ballistic missiles and drones, air defence downs two Iskanders and 255 UAVs
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched ballistic missiles and 280 drones overnight, with Kyiv bearing the brunt of the assault. Air defences destroyed or jammed 257 assets by 09:00.

items.title: Humanitarian mission gets underway in Oleshky, Budanov says
items.teaser: A humanitarian mission has got underway in Oleshky, with a bilateral ceasefire declared in the area of the operation.

items.title: War update: 196 combat engagements on frontline in past day as Russian pressure intensifies on Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka axes
items.teaser: A total of 196 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian troops were reported along the front line on October 26.

items.title: Specialists assess damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge after ballistic missile strike
items.teaser: Specialists are assessing damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge following a Russian ballistic missile strike overnight on October 27.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Kyjiw: Ein Toter, 14 Verletzte
items.teaser: Seit dem Abend des 26. Oktober wurden infolge der Angriffe der Russen mit ballistischen Raketen auf die Hauptstadt ein Mensch getötet und 14 weitere verletzt.

items.title: Russland und Ukraine beginnen Waffenruhe für Frontstadt Oleschky
items.teaser: Seit Jahren ist die von Russland besetzte Stadt Oleschky in der Ostukraine umkämpft. Trotzdem leben dort noch bis zu 2.000 Menschen. Damit sie Hilfe bekommen, gilt jetzt eine Feuerpause. Andernorts gehen die Angriffe weiter.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv kills one person and injures 14
items.teaser: Since the evening of October 26, one person has been killed and 14 others wounded as a result of enemy attacks on the capital.

items.title: Raumschiff Enterprise - "Star Trek"-Schauspieler Walter Koenig mit 90 Jahren gestorben
items.teaser: Der aus "Raumschiff Enterprise" bekannte US-Schauspieler Walter Koenig ist im Alter von 90 Jahren gestorben. Das teilte sein Agent mit.

items.title: Russia loses another 1,400 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
items.teaser: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to October 27, 2026—amount to approximately 1,581,840 personnel, including 1,400 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: 1400 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 27. Oktober 2026 werden auf etwa 1.581840 (+1400 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Kyiv mayor shares photos of damage to Pivdennyi Bridge
items.teaser: The Pivdennyi Bridge remains closed to traffic in Kyiv as specialist services assess damage caused by a Russian missile strike overnight. Metro services between Osokorky and Chervonyi Khutir stations are also suspended.

items.title: Russian nighttime attack on Kyiv causes several hits, including on administrative building
items.teaser: As a result of yet another ballistic attack by Russian forces in the Podilsky district of the capital, an administrative building was hit.

items.title: 11KM-Podcast: Trump und die Ukraine - Was will der US-Präsident?
items.teaser: Die Ukraine steht vor dem Winter unter enormem militärischem Druck durch Russland und ist weiter auf Unterstützung der USA angewiesen. 11KM über die große Unbekannte - Donald Trump.

items.title: Russia's assault on Ukraine's energy grid is a war crime, UN says
items.teaser: Russia’s attacks on energy infrastructure, which weaponize winter to inflict suffering, amount to war crimes, a UN inquiry has found.

items.title: Ukrainian media face pressure as they step up scrutiny of authorities in wartime
items.teaser: Over the past year, Ukrainian independent media have stepped up investigations into corruption among top officials and abuse in the military, despite the constraints and risks of Russia’s full-scale invasion. items.title: Anschlag bei Hannover? - Mehrere Verletzte! Auto rast in Menschenmenge
items.teaser: Vier bis fünf Menschen wurden verletzt, die Täter entkamen zu Fuß.

items.title: Zelensky after Russian strike on Kyiv: Delays in air defense support Ukraine enable terrorism
items.teaser: Amid the constant threat of Russian airstrikes, artificial delays in the delivery of air defense systems to protect Ukraine only serve to fuel terror.

items.title: Two Russian missile strikes on Kyiv leave one dead and 14 injured overnight
items.teaser: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko says two waves of Russian missile attacks since the evening of 26 October have left one person dead and 14 injured, with nine people taken to hospital.

items.title: Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv kills one, injures 10 and damages medical facilities and school
items.teaser: During the air raid alert in the capital, explosions were heard—Russian forces attacked the city with ballistic missiles.

items.title: Russian sabotage network behind Romanian arson attack, officials say
items.teaser: The attack is "part of a larger campaign of sabotage operations attributed to the Russian Federation in Europe," according to the Romanian Intelligence Service.

items.title: Melania Trump’s chief adviser: Russia pledges to respect Oleshky residents’ evacuation choices
items.teaser: Russia has assured Ukraine and the United States that it will respect the choice of residents of the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region regarding their evacuation destination.

items.title: Russia loses 1,400 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,400 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Zelensky enacts NSDC decision on national security strategy

items.title: Pivdennyi Bridge in Kyiv closed to traffic after Russian ballistic missile strike
items.teaser: A Russian missile hit the Pivdennyi Bridge during an overnight attack on Kyiv, damaging metro infrastructure and disrupting train services on two lines as well as surface public transport.

items.title: Ukraine's defence forces strike Russian ammunition depot in Luhansk Oblast – video
items.teaser: A drone attack targeted a Russian military ammunition depot near Khrustalnyi overnight, triggering a major fire and secondary ammunition detonations. Neither Russian nor Ukrainian military officials have issued an official statement.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia begin Oleshky ceasefire for aid mission
items.teaser: Around 2,000 people remain stranded in the city of Oleshky, facing severe shortages of food and medicine. The Russian-occupied town has been devastated by fighting and flooding since Moscow's invasion in 2022.

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Local ceasefire in besieged Oleshky begins, Ukrainian, Russian officials say
items.teaser: A ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid to enter the Russian occupied city began as Russian forces launched ballistic missiles at other parts of Ukraine.

items.title: Russia expanding recruitment of African mercenaries amid heavy losses in Ukraine war – Bloomberg
items.teaser: Russia is expanding the range of African countries from which it recruits men to address a shortage of personnel in its armed forces amid the war against Ukraine, where it is suffering heavy losses.

items.title: Romania uncovers Russian sabotage network that attempted to set fire to arms factory – video
items.teaser: Romania's intelligence service says three suspects linked to a Russian-coordinated network attempted to set fire to the Carfil arms factory in Brașov. The investigation has uncovered suspected plans to target military and industrial facilities across Europe.

items.title: Economy Ministry again revises 2026 GDP forecast downward
items.teaser: The Ministry of Economy is once again revising its forecast for GDP growth in 2026, this time toward a lower estimate.

items.title: Ceasefire begins near Oleshky in Kherson Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine and Russia have introduced a ceasefire in a designated area around Oleshky in Kherson Oblast to prepare for a humanitarian operation, with the arrangement coordinated through US First Lady Melania Trump.

items.title: Russia no longer one of world’s top three thermal coal exporters
items.teaser: Moscow has lost its position as the third-largest global thermal coal exporter, accounting for nearly half of the total global drop in coal trade volume.
